title: 第2494章 不信可以试试第2493章 第四件帝兵
content_zh:
世人震惊、错愕，炼仙壶摄入三大帝兵，竟然是想要让三大帝兵静养千年？
“若是四件帝兵齐出，未必没有战胜黑暗帝主的可能，只是……可惜了！”
三大主界有强者扼腕叹息，此战未能战胜黑暗帝主，还让帝兵沉寂，他们三大主界今后的日子可不好过了！
“你到底是什么人？又让炼仙壶对帝兵做了什么？”
九霄圣王惊吼。
“我是什么人不重要，重要的是，你们的帝兵，神祇有部分被仙火炼化，没有千年时间无法复原。
我劝你们还是低调些，别像以往那般张狂了。”
幽暗的虚无空间深处，一道冷笑之音在回荡。
“混账！”
几大圣王暴怒，杀意强烈，可他们的神念却无法捕捉到对方的存在，对方的真身恐怕根本不在这片空间内。
“隔着百座界域，还借炼仙壶在另一个方位传音，此人果然谨慎。”
南天界主凝声说道，对方的出手，不仅导致他们的同盟功亏一篑，还损毁了帝兵神祇，无疑让他们元气大伤！
双方的梁子，结的很深。
帝兵的神祇虽然损毁了部分，无法完全复苏，爆发出全盛状态的巅峰战力，可内部的帝道法则还在，依然有帝级的法纹，只要几大圣王愿意付出足够的神材，还是能让帝兵显威的。
除非帝主出手，真正除掉了三大绝顶圣王，不然此人多半不会显露真实身份，避免正面碰撞。
“真的是姜族吗？”
萧沉心中一叹，炼仙壶先是对黑暗帝主出手，后又突袭三大帝兵，若是姜族在背后主导，他们的目的是什么？
让世间仅有炼仙壶一件帝兵独尊？
可就算是这样，还有黑暗帝主、绝仙教主等惊世强者在，姜族也不见得能够君临天下。
就在萧沉猜测对方用意之际，一股本能的危险之意袭来，他的寒毛倒竖而起，神色惊变，第一时间横移出去数十万里！

南天界主似乎也有所察觉，在萧沉横移之时就出手了，一掌拍向了萧沉的上空，那里，有一尊恐怖的大手掌压落，透着绝杀天下之威，仙道符文璀璨，同时还有无边杀意弥漫。
“嘭”
的一声，南天界主的身影被震飞出去数万里，一口圣王血喷落，对方的掌力的余波冲击到萧沉的身上，竟让他横飞而起，鲜血狂涌，五脏六腑仿佛都要碎裂开来！
南天主界的人俱都大惊失色，要知道，南天界主已经站在圣王境界第三个小台阶上，说是绝顶圣王也不为过，唯有太初神主等人和他处在同一层次。
萧沉也可战圣王了，非无缺的圣王，甚至不是他的对手，会被他诛杀。
可南天界主却被这一掌拍飞了，余波都让萧沉横飞、喋血，出手之人该是何等强大与狠辣！
“还算有点本事，竟没有被我这一掌震死。”
双方碰撞的原地，一尊模糊的身影出现，盯着南天界主飞出去的方向冷冷自语，而后目光转过，盯上了萧沉！
“跟我走吧！”
那尊模糊的身影怒喝，手掌再度探出，恐怖的仙道法则力量绽放，萧沉只觉得一股无形的力量犹如大手般禁锢住了自己，让他动弹不得，无法挣脱！
“准帝……”
萧沉艰难地吐出两个字，猜到了对方的身份！
绝仙教主！
唯有准帝层次的人，或者拥有帝兵的强者，才敢在这种时候出手，且能伤到南天界主！
content_en:
The world was shocked and astonished. The Immortal Refining Pot took in three imperial soldiers, and actually wanted to let the three imperial soldiers rest for a thousand years?
"If all four imperial weapons are sent out at the same time, it may not be impossible to defeat the Dark Emperor, but... it's a pity!"
The strong men in the three main realms sighed with regret. This battle failed to defeat the Dark Emperor and silenced the imperial soldiers. The future of their three main realms will not be easy!
"Who are you? What did you let the Immortal Refining Pot do to the Imperial Soldiers?"
The Holy King of Nine Heavens screamed.
"It doesn't matter who I am, what's important is that your imperial soldiers and gods are partially refined by the immortal fire and cannot be restored in a thousand years.
I advise you to keep a low profile and not be as arrogant as before. "
Deep in the dark void space, a sneer echoed.
"Asshole!"
Several holy kings were furious and had strong murderous intentions, but their spiritual thoughts could not capture the existence of each other. I am afraid that the other party's true body was not in this space at all.
"Across a hundred realms, he also used the Immortal Refining Pot to transmit sounds in another direction. This person is really cautious."
The Master of Nantian Realm said in a solemn voice, the opponent's attack not only caused their alliance to fall short, but also damaged the emperor's weapons and gods, which undoubtedly greatly damaged their vitality!
The relationship between the two sides is very deep.
Although the gods of the Imperial Armament were partially damaged and could not fully recover and exploded to their peak combat power, the internal laws of the Imperial Dao were still there, and there were still Emperor-level patterns. As long as a few great saint kings were willing to pay enough divine materials, the Imperial Armament could still show its power.
Unless the emperor takes action and truly eliminates the three supreme holy kings, this person will most likely not reveal his true identity to avoid a head-on collision.
"Is it really the Jiang clan?"
Xiao Chen sighed in his heart. The Immortal Refining Pot first attacked the Dark Emperor, and then attacked the three emperor soldiers. If the Jiang clan was behind the scenes, what was their purpose?
Let the Immortal Refining Pot be the only imperial weapon in the world?
But even so, with the presence of the Dark Emperor, the Absolute Immortal Leader and other shockingly powerful people, the Jiang Clan may not be able to dominate the world.
Just when Xiao Chen guessed the other party's intention, an instinctive sense of danger came over him. His hair stood on end, his expression changed with shock, and he immediately moved hundreds of thousands of miles away!
The Nantian Realm Master seemed to be aware of it, and took action when Xiao Chen moved sideways. He slapped a palm in the sky above Xiao Chen. There, there was a terrifying big palm pressing down, showing the power of killing the world, the immortal runes were bright, and there was boundless murderous intention.
"Bang"
With a bang, the figure of Nantian Realm Master was sent flying tens of thousands of miles, and a mouthful of Saint King's blood spurted out. The aftermath of the opponent's palm force impacted Xiao Chen's body, causing him to fly up, blood gushing wildly, and his internal organs seemed to be shattered!
Everyone in the Nantian Lord Realm was shocked. You must know that the Nantian Realm Lord is already standing on the third small step of the Holy King Realm. It is not an exaggeration to say that he is the ultimate Holy King. Only the Supreme God Lord and others are at the same level as him.
Xiao Chen can also fight the Holy King. The Holy King who is not Wuque, or even his opponent, will be killed by him.
But Nantian Realm Master was knocked away by this palm, and the aftermath made Xiao Chen fly and bleed. How powerful and ruthless the person who took action must be!
"You are quite capable, but you were not shocked to death by my palm."
Where the two sides collided, a vague figure appeared, staring at the direction in which Nantian Realm Master flew out, muttering coldly to himself, and then turned his eyes and stared at Xiao Chen!
"Come with me!"
The vague figure shouted angrily, and stretched out its palm again, and the terrifying power of the Immortal Law bloomed. Xiao Chen only felt that an invisible force was restraining him like a big hand, making him unable to move and unable to break free!
"Quasi Emperor..."
Xiao Chen uttered two words with difficulty and guessed the identity of the other party!
The Immortal Leader!
Only people at the quasi-emperor level, or strong men with imperial weapons, dare to take action at this time and can hurt the Nantian Realm Lord!
